business_problem: Transactional diligence requires lawyers to review large volumes of documents under tight deadlines, identify risks and liabilities, and prepare analyses that can consume days of intensive work.
solution_summary: Ropes & Gray's proprietary transactional diligence AI tool works across full deal data rooms rather than isolated contracts. It takes a first pass through thousands of pages, identifies relevant documents, groups them by themes and issues, and produces summaries plus a report in the firm's format. The firm's workflow applies a consistent query and review framework from initial document review through summaries and higher-level analysis; lawyers compare draft outputs with human-authored reports from completed deals and refine the rubric and report format. The tool exposes interim summaries and source documents for lawyer inspection, so attorneys validate the work before any client deliverable. The page identifies ChatGPT and GPT-6 Astra but does not detail the tool's ingestion stack, storage layer, hosting, or other integrations.
